programme.title: 博物館的祕密 3 #4
programme.desc: 本週《博物館的祕密》聚焦產業與設計。策展人馬丁準備展出莫里斯・布魯姆菲爾德的攝影展,珍妮收到稀有的 Biba 生產檔案,另展出一條佳姆丹尼紗巾與喬賽亞・韋奇伍德的陶瓷試作品。

programme.title: 博物館的祕密 3 #5
programme.desc: 本週,修復師 Adriana 清潔一座唐納泰羅雕像,西蒙收到海倫・米倫在《女王登場》中穿過的戲服,克里斯多福會見設計師肯尼斯・格蘭奇爵士,而 VA 鄧迪館邀請藝術家 Yinka Ilori 設計一座色彩繽紛的迷宮。

programme.title: 廣告界奇才 #1
programme.desc: 且看50年代的廣告活動如何推出新的美國傳統和明天會更好的承諾。

programme.title: 博物館的祕密 3 #4
programme.desc: 本週《博物館的祕密》聚焦產業與設計。策展人馬丁準備展出莫里斯・布魯姆菲爾德的攝影展,珍妮收到稀有的 Biba 生產檔案,另展出一條佳姆丹尼紗巾與喬賽亞・韋奇伍德的陶瓷試作品。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #1
programme.desc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園。懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子。兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為「力」的奇觀。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中。溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥、覓食和躲避掠食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #3
programme.desc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖、魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英里西非遷徙、三文魚返回牠們出生的河流、極北蝰產子的季節。

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #6
programme.desc: 在愛爾蘭,雙胞胎與伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球對決、傳統舞蹈、《哈利波特》回憶殺,並揭開詭譎迷人的鄉間冒險序幕!

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #2
programme.desc: 廖崇明從當地穆斯林家庭學習製作正宗巴東牛肉。他到訪新加坡國家檔案館查找母親家族的資料,並繼續尋找新加坡國宴的靈感。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #3
programme.desc: 廖崇明到訪峇峇娘惹美食傳奇人物溫美玉的餐廳- 國家廚房。然後,他前往牛車水參觀澳洲人大衛偏特的餐廳- Burnt Ends。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明尋找新加坡最好的海鮮。他從濱海灣金沙酒店出發,那裡有許多名廚開設的餐廳。

programme.title: 席琳狄翁: 愛無止境
programme.desc: 席琳狄翁是家喻戶曉的名字,象徵著無與倫比的音樂才華。然而,她的人生並非一帆風順。跟隨我們一同揭開傳奇背後的故事——從聲名鵲起的爆紅之路,到塑造她非凡事業的個人考驗。

programme.title: 羅傑費德勒: 冠軍之路
programme.desc: 溫布頓體育館的榮譽委員會充滿了傑出的名字。在1998 年,又添一個。羅渣費達拿。從任何意義上來說,他登上男子比賽巔峰的旅程就是真正的冠軍之旅。

programme.title: 電影大師 #1
programme.desc: 沒有多少電影製作人能像史蒂芬史匹柏一樣在業內50多年間如此生生不息和擁有影響力,他從亞利桑那州郊區到荷里活聚光燈下的旅程是有史以來最偉大的故事之一。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #3
programme.desc: 夏天代表食物充足,今年的幼崽們必須進食、長大並準備自立。對海鸚來說,當從懸崖頂的巢穴跳落大海時,實在是一次巨大的信仰之躍。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #4
programme.desc: 在大西洋最北端,秋季是大風、涼意和大雨的季節。野生動物於此時必須為過冬做足最後準備,或遷移到溫暖的地區。

programme.title: 美洲豹國度
programme.desc: 探索潘塔納爾濕地400平方英里的地區,這裡由美洲豹統治,生命都遵循著水的季節節奏。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《两条鲨鱼的故事》中,我们将看看南非海岸发现的各种各样的鲨鱼,重点关注濒临灭绝的路氏双髻鲨和标志性的大白鲨。

programme.title: 恐龍效應
programme.desc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #1
programme.desc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往巴西,一群巨型發電船正處於解決當地逼切的電力需求的最後階段。它們對抗風浪,趕在限期前為200萬戶家庭提供盡可能多的電力。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #2
programme.desc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信、最複雜的天文台之一- ALMA。他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線。

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #7
programme.desc: 了解冷战时期英国旗舰超级喷气式飞机霍克猎人的内幕,以及它在 20 世纪末最惊心动魄的飞行。

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #8
programme.desc: C-47 最初设计为民用客机,后来成为耐用的军用主力飞机,用于在诺曼底登陆日将伞兵运送到敌后,营救受伤士兵等。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #1
programme.desc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #3
programme.desc: 夏天代表食物充足,今年的幼崽們必須進食、長大並準備自立。對海鸚來說,當從懸崖頂的巢穴跳落大海時,實在是一次巨大的信仰之躍。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #4
programme.desc: 在大西洋最北端,秋季是大風、涼意和大雨的季節。野生動物於此時必須為過冬做足最後準備,或遷移到溫暖的地區。

programme.title: 美洲豹國度
programme.desc: 探索潘塔納爾濕地400平方英里的地區,這裡由美洲豹統治,生命都遵循著水的季節節奏。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《两条鲨鱼的故事》中,我们将看看南非海岸发现的各种各样的鲨鱼,重点关注濒临灭绝的路氏双髻鲨和标志性的大白鲨。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #3
programme.desc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖、魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英里西非遷徙、三文魚返回牠們出生的河流、極北蝰產子的季節。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #4
programme.desc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息。歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴。

programme.title: 冰島: 海鸚保護區
programme.desc: 討人喜歡、被視為「滑稽」的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂。長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖。少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 2 #5
programme.desc: 花園大道果真是南非的滄海遺珠,它是一條延伸200公里的沿海公路,以其迷人的多樣性和無出其右的荒野而聞名。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 2 #6
programme.desc: 華倫抵達開普敦,這不會是這座城市的平凡美食探索之旅;華倫在整集節目中致力深入研究南非一種特殊的烹飪風格- 開普馬來。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 2 #7
programme.desc: 華倫在法蘭史霍克山谷探索博殊真度紅酒莊的無盡產物。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 2 #8
programme.desc: 華倫繼續從心出發,前往更鮮為人知的赫爾馬努斯小鎮,在當地參觀紐頓莊臣-「風景優美的紅酒農場」,從而加深對紅酒的熱愛。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 2 #9
programme.desc: 華倫正離開開普敦前往西開普省更寧靜的沿海地區和風景如畫的帕特諾斯特小鎮。他在當地會驚嘆海邊村莊的氛圍,並沿著海灘騎電動單車。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 2 #10
programme.desc: 作為華倫南非美食之旅的最後一章,他回歸叢林,這是所有前往彩虹國度旅行的精髓。

programme.title: 電影大師 #1
programme.desc: 沒有多少電影製作人能像史蒂芬史匹柏一樣在業內50多年間如此生生不息和擁有影響力,他從亞利桑那州郊區到荷里活聚光燈下的旅程是有史以來最偉大的故事之一。

programme.title: 電影大師 #2
programme.desc: 自60年前導演的處女作面世,馬丁史柯西斯一生一直致力為電影的過去、現在和未來打拼。他被稱為「電影保母」,他不斷突破電影製作的極限。

programme.title: 電影大師 #3
programme.desc: 自90年代初,昆汀塔倫提諾一直乘坐從不減速的電影過山車,這也鞏固了他那世上最具影響力的電影製作人之一的地位。

programme.title: 伊比利之森 #1
programme.desc: 春夏季的林地是如火如荼的繁殖季節,引人注目的特技有助確保牠們繁殖後代,並克服持續的挑戰。

programme.title: 伊比利之森 #2
programme.desc: 在地中海森林的秋冬季,新生兒當自強,而物種間的爭競也達到巔峰,持續的挑戰有時會浴血方休。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #1
programme.desc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #2
programme.desc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命。在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #3
programme.desc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量。這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #4
programme.desc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #5
programme.desc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #6
programme.desc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #7
programme.desc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #8
programme.desc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #2
programme.desc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信、最複雜的天文台之一- ALMA。他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #3
programme.desc: 全球疫情導致世上唯一的水底棲息地停運。米克大衛臣加入裂縫修復小組,一同潛入水中修復它,並讓美國太空總署的太空人返回內部進行訓練。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #4
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的「重型運輸機」中隊。他們致力保持CH53「超級種馬」直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備。

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #8
programme.desc: C-47 最初设计为民用客机,后来成为耐用的军用主力飞机,用于在诺曼底登陆日将伞兵运送到敌后,营救受伤士兵等。

programme.title: 巨型長毛象的足跡
programme.desc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復。我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程。透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #1
programme.desc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態。從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 2 #9
programme.desc: 華倫正離開開普敦前往西開普省更寧靜的沿海地區和風景如畫的帕特諾斯特小鎮。他在當地會驚嘆海邊村莊的氛圍,並沿著海灘騎電動單車。

programme.title: 北領地好味道 #1
programme.desc: 占美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔、農夫和每週採購的當地人之間。

programme.title: 北領地好味道 #2
programme.desc: 占美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市。

programme.title: 北領地好味道 #3
programme.desc: 占美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好、最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹。

programme.title: 北領地好味道 #4
programme.desc: 占美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食。

programme.title: 電影大師 #3
programme.desc: 自90年代初,昆汀塔倫提諾一直乘坐從不減速的電影過山車,這也鞏固了他那世上最具影響力的電影製作人之一的地位。

programme.title: 電影大師 #4
programme.desc: 史派克李一直是位備受爭議和政治性的電影製作人,他的電影就是最好的證據。自40多年前處女作面世,他一直在美國突破界限。

programme.title: 賀錦麗: 明日傳奇
programme.desc: 本紀錄片探討賀錦麗從早年加州的生活到成為首位美國女性副總統的崛起經過、她對美國政壇的影響以及她有望成為首位女總統的潛力。

programme.title: 丹佐華盛頓: 美國代表人物
programme.desc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力。

programme.title: 摩根費里曼: 不可思議的生涯
programme.desc: 深入探索摩根・費里曼的人生旅程——從奮鬥與逆境,到塑造好萊塢的傳奇地位與獨一無二的標誌性嗓音。

programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 地球上的一段生命旅程
programme.desc: 大衛艾登堡爵士是一位傳奇的傳播者和教育家,在過去六十多年裡遊歷全球,用他那引人入勝的說故事技巧啟發數百萬人,並將自然世界帶入我們家中。

programme.title: 拉斐爾納達爾: 紅土球王
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片深入探討網球傳奇拉斐爾納達爾的人生,探索他從神童成長為全球巨星的歷程。透過眾多勝利和挑戰揭示拿度在球場內外所貢獻的遺產。(V374)

programme.title: 克林伊斯威特: 自得其樂
programme.desc: 奇連伊士活是一個演員、導演和慈善家。從典型的西方偶像,到磨練他的技藝和關懷的個性。這就是他波瀾壯闊的人生故事。

programme.title: 瑪麗亞凱莉: 毅力與魅力
programme.desc: 瑪麗亞凱莉的人生宛如童話般的灰姑娘故事。至尊歌后、聖誕女王、熱心公益的慈善家——她已售出超過 22 億張唱片,並推出史上最暢銷的聖誕專輯。

programme.title: 賀錦麗: 明日傳奇
programme.desc: 本紀錄片探討賀錦麗從早年加州的生活到成為首位美國女性副總統的崛起經過、她對美國政壇的影響以及她有望成為首位女總統的潛力。

programme.title: 女神卡卡: 為舞而生
programme.desc: 從地下俱樂部到全球巨星,《女神卡卡: 為舞而生》探索這位重新定義音樂、時尚與名聲的流行偶像勢不可擋的崛起之路。在勝利與挫折交織的人生中,見證卡卡如何以舞步迎戰挑戰,並最終勝出。

programme.title: 成名之旅 #1
programme.desc: 專訪瑪丹娜第一任經理人卡繆巴龐、舞者卡爾頓威爾邦、艾薇塔工作室執行官羅倫萊等人。

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #9
programme.desc: 航空历史学家和退伍军人详细描述了 Ju-87 斯图卡轰炸机的高速俯冲和精准度如何成为二战期间纳粹恐怖武器和德国力量的象征

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #10
programme.desc: 专家们讨论了 AH-1 眼镜蛇的历史,这是一款灵活的攻击直升机,专为越南战争而设计,后来用于伊拉克战争中危险的地面支援任务。

programme.title: 丹佐華盛頓: 美國代表人物
programme.desc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力。

programme.title: 摩根費里曼: 不可思議的生涯
programme.desc: 深入探索摩根・費里曼的人生旅程——從奮鬥與逆境,到塑造好萊塢的傳奇地位與獨一無二的標誌性嗓音。

programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 地球上的一段生命旅程
programme.desc: 大衛艾登堡爵士是一位傳奇的傳播者和教育家,在過去六十多年裡遊歷全球,用他那引人入勝的說故事技巧啟發數百萬人,並將自然世界帶入我們家中。

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr Matt tackles some weighty issues when the fattest parrot he has ever seen pays him a visit, in the sixth programme of the series Matt conducts an emergency caesarean to save the life of Penny the cat, and helps a swan which has been the victim of a brutal mugging

programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts"nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show" These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Thornton Heath, South London, Inspector Nick Wheelhouse is called out to see three adult mastiffs and nine puppies who are all drastically underweight Will Gaza, the mother and the skinniest of the dogs, be able to regain the weight she so desperately needs

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts"nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show" These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!nThey are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 09 meters in size and live over 100 years But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet to bring you the most hilarious clips of Budgies (and other birds) on the planet, not so much -§who's a clever boy-¨ as -§who's a funny boy-¨! Flying fails, performing Parrots and the real life angry birds -V we've assembled the very best the web has to offer, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The charm of cute rabbits is irresistible! An old man raised hundreds of rabbits?! Playful little rabbits are spoiled yet timid! What should beginners pay attention to when raising rabbits?! Shocking! Rabbits can be poisoned by eating carrots?! Rabbits have a very bad temper?! They kick people they don't like?! Crazy about rabbits! Caregivers takes care of the little rabbits "wholeheartedly"?!

programme.desc: 被稱為英雄王的老國王英格利斯為王國和人民奉獻了一生。面臨人生最終時刻的他向女神亞莉絲泰爾許願,表示若能重生便想畢生專精武藝。他轉生為名叫英格莉絲的女性後,在還是嬰兒時就學會凝聚靈素,擊倒魔石獸。 五歲時便能閉著眼打贏偷用魔術的拉哈爾。

programme.title: 英雄王,為了窮盡武道而轉生~而後成為世界最強見習騎士♀~ #2
programme.desc: 英格莉絲和拉菲妮亞在六歲時為了成為騎士而參加受洗。拉菲妮亞獲得上級魔印,但英格莉絲卻自願成為無印者。十二歲時兩人前往王都,巧遇天上人的拉哈爾,並在聖騎士里昂的介紹下結識天惠武姬的厄麗絲。深夜時,與厄麗絲相遇的英格莉絲決定藉此機會與她切磋。

programme.desc: 被稱為英雄王的老國王英格利斯為王國和人民奉獻了一生。面臨人生最終時刻的他向女神亞莉絲泰爾許願,表示若能重生便想畢生專精武藝。他轉生為名叫英格莉絲的女性後,在還是嬰兒時就學會凝聚靈素,擊倒魔石獸。 五歲時便能閉著眼打贏偷用魔術的拉哈爾。

programme.title: 英雄王,為了窮盡武道而轉生~而後成為世界最強見習騎士♀~ #2
programme.desc: 英格莉絲和拉菲妮亞在六歲時為了成為騎士而參加受洗。拉菲妮亞獲得上級魔印,但英格莉絲卻自願成為無印者。十二歲時兩人前往王都,巧遇天上人的拉哈爾,並在聖騎士里昂的介紹下結識天惠武姬的厄麗絲。深夜時,與厄麗絲相遇的英格莉絲決定藉此機會與她切磋。

programme.title: 海賊王 #43
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 英雄王,為了窮盡武道而轉生~而後成為世界最強見習騎士♀~ #4
programme.desc: 英格莉絲與天惠武姬之一的希絲緹亞對峙,兩人展開激烈的攻防戰。對方使出致命一擊,但英格莉絲成功扭轉戰況,擊敗對手。事後執政官席蘭妮赦免了反叛騎士的罪行並宣布關於天上領的新計畫。她卻因為服用虹粉藥變成魔石獸,遭血鐵鎖旅團的首領黑假面男攻擊。

programme.title: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #12
programme.desc: 隨著夏天的結束,高地半獸人在探索森林時遭到狼和熊的攻擊。誠尋求平靜,但遇到的熊卻對他表現出敵意。

programme.title: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #13
programme.desc: 隨著學校祭典的臨近,信仰女神的神殿準祭司西耐來找真。她告訴真,葛之葉商會所販售的藥品在市面上有不好的傳聞。西耐提出,如果真能向神殿公開藥品的製作過程,神殿就會協助消除這些謠言。真對這個建議。

programme.title: 海賊王 #43

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:「壓力」真的無法擋? 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影: 亞洲英雄-沒有硝煙的戰爭
programme.desc: 自古亂世出英雄,在2003年春天的一場沒有硝煙的戰爭中,一群捨己救人的真英雄誕生了。在一輪出生入死的拚搏過後,寫下了香港杏林史上引以為傲的一頁,亦叫早己冷卻的心再一次跳動。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蘇穎睿牧師-信心之旅
programme.desc: 希伯來書除了論證耶穌基督的超越性之外,字裡行間隨時都有對猶太信徒的勸勉,因為這些猶太信徒受本族人的壓力,產生許多疑難,信心開始動搖。藉着希伯來書,蘇穎睿牧師帶你走進歷史,閱覽這趟考驗信心之旅。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:克服現實不似預期的挑戰 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。n第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

高朋滿座#89粵
programme.desc: 強訛稱慶兩個月沒發工資而不給家用，眾提議將他辭退。妙下定決心辭退強。但強知道此事後假扮在藥房內跌倒，令喜難以辭退他。受傷的強變本加厲，除向義索取保險賠償，四出借錢，最後更帶家人到藥房要求供膳。

programme.title: 尚食#29粵普PG
programme.desc: 子衿要懲治蘇月華，孟尚宮自損雙手代月華贖罪，並辭去尚宮一職。災荒多發，瞻基對工部勞民傷財之舉十分不滿，下令減少宮內開支。子衿查閱宮廷帳冊，向太后指出負責採買的內宦貪污嚴重，並故意讓袁琦聽見。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺與阿譚選購高級日本刺參，產自關東、關西的刺參各有何特色？鼎爺先示範「肉蓉釀關西遼參」，以豬肉、鮮墨魚、馬蹄等製作餡料，釀進已發透的關西遼參。記低鼎爺發海參的竅門。將釀好的遼參以上湯煨熟，上碟後淋上芡汁，滋味更佳。鼎爺與阿譚再到燒臘舖搜羅靚叉燒，製作港式「揚州炒飯」，亦以金華火腿炮製懷舊版「揚州炒飯」，鹹香美味。炒飯時宜先將蛋炒至半熟才加飯同炒，關火後才加入蔥粒，看鼎爺示範炒飯步驟。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 一項研究稱射精與可減低患前列腺癌風險或有關，泌尿外科醫生概述研究結果，還提醒男士如出現血精或小便帶血，應及早求醫。醫生亦詳析前列腺癌診治資訊，並建議多吃煮熟的番茄作預防。薛家燕回顧入行68年，感恩能將興趣變成終身事業。她憶述於《六指琴魔》反串一事，更難忘獲前輩梁醒波提攜！家燕姐從未演奸角，應大王所求首次擺出「奸相」。據悉她被長女「勒令」減少工作，可有其事？「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「酸蘿蔔豬肉湯」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 多項研究發現，男士出現脫髮的人口比率約20%，比例相當高。《醫度講》這集請來莊鍶敏細談如何受到脫髮問題影響，陳佔耀醫生則詳析脫髮的成因與治療方法。註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會在節目中跟大家分享有助改善脫髮情況的食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#21粵
programme.desc: 雙春與九妹決定回吳篤村前向若嵐辭行，遇上食客鼓譟，九妹只得暫代大廚之職。食客對菜式大表滿意，南天王心腹李先生更邀請喜相逢成為佼佼鎮的代表參加「省港澳廚藝比試」。永禎請字畫鑑賞家檢驗安山的遺書，得知是偽造。永禎用「調戲喜伯妻子」一事要脅關氏兄弟用轎把雙春抬回鎮中。永禎跟蹤曼娣，終得知她與飛揚間的關係。永禎欲灌醉飛揚套取消息，卻只得知他甚痛恨永安山。飛揚帶永禎談生意時遇佟大貴；飛揚突然要永禎離開。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 撒哈拉沙漠竟會舉行馬拉松賽事？曾參與的跑者亮相節目，分享參賽點滴。跑者指沙漠近五十度的日夜溫差是大考驗，遇上沙塵暴時更是伸手不見五指。他還曾於沙漠迷路，幸藉輪椅選手留下的痕跡才抵達終點。他亦以自身經歷，寄語小朋友遇到困難要冷靜思考，尋找解決方法。嘉賓亦曾參與北極馬拉松，賽前在港於冰粒生產廠特訓，比賽時卻發現溫度截然不同？他憶述難忘比賽經歷，被一位十二歲少年跑者觸動，隨後亦成立了推動傷健共融的團體。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 麵檔老闆感嘆生意難做，多啦A夢借他「客似雲來喇叭」，誰知卻啟發胖虎炮製拉麵甚至開檔。為了讓胖虎一嘗真正觸電的滋味，多啦A夢把「充電衣」借給大雄，但後者卻沒有接地線，導致電力不斷累積。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
programme.desc: 政府早前調高億元豪宅印花稅，對市況影響有多大？筆架山一個放盤質素如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
才駿Hashtag 法興輪證30週年粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 秀茂坪某學校附近驚現中年裸男，校方提醒學生出入小心。節目組接獲某單幢大廈的居民投訴，指稱有住戶父子於屋苑內橫行霸道，威嚇及辱罵其他居民，甚至疑似包庇管理員的不當行為。外景主持嘗試向該對父子探問情況，對方不但否認指控，更反指是遭有心人誣蔑？《2026香港小姐競選》全球招募記者會，多位前港姐亦到場支持，送上活動花絮。有國際連鎖零售集團慶祝創立185周年，並於早前舉行店舖及員工頒獎禮。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2799粵
programme.desc: 因某些理由，家聰與卜卜脆互有嫌隙，偶然發現她的學歷似有可疑，經查證後聯同力蓮向Ceci揭穿謊言，詎料……Ceci待卜卜脆極好，引起不少猜測。若水等人提到一些發現，令某個說法更顯得言之鑿鑿。其後，家聰、力王發現卜卜脆遭人綁架，欲救人時亦一併被擒。綁匪向Ceci、敢威索取天價贖金，敢威打算報警，Ceci卻為救卜卜脆不惜任何代價。家聰認定卜卜脆跟Ceci關係非比尋常，遂想設法幫她，為此嘗盡苦頭……

programme.title: I LOAN U 網上貸款平台呈獻：重案解密#1粵PG
programme.desc: 無人商場發生孕婦被剖腹取走胎兒案件，因為人跡罕至和沒有閉路電視，重案組難以找出兇手，及後陸續發現兩具被遺棄胎兒；子瑤借故邀約美珍到家裡再將她打暈，打算取出胎兒，鍾琛及思怡到達，子瑤假裝自己也被打暈…

programme.title: 大生意人#21粵普
programme.desc: 古母質問李萬堂，眾人終於得知真相，原來李萬堂就是她當年失蹤的丈夫，也是害古平原考場被抓走的人。李萬堂決定終生留在寺裡贖罪，李欽認為是古平原和古母害他父親出家，表示要在生意場上打敗古平原，逼他一家消失。

programme.title: 海馬牌床褥呈獻：魔音女團粵
programme.desc: 《魔音女團》開學禮啟動！十六位練習生逐一現身集訓基地，訴說演藝點滴與「成魔」緣由。不少參賽者都想撇甩魔音標籤，全面提升「唱、跳、Rap、睇」魅力，企C位發光發亮，有人卻為結識朋友？主持蕭正楠、「班主任」陳潔靈、陳奐仁、形象指導馬天佑、服裝指導Kev Yiu、美妝指導Carrie Cammy、「助教」黃洛妍、冼靖峰、文佐匡，齊集與眾人見面，要將不可能任務變成可能，韓國偶像學院社長亦拍片向練習生打氣！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#19粵PG
programme.desc: 婉芳曾被游泳教練非禮，國棟懷疑色魔是泳會教練，到泳會搜查。國樑到泳會找情人胡德明，赫見國棟即躲起來。健碩查得攝影愛好者江永健曾替泳會拍宣傳片，懷疑他與強姦案有關。楊光突接Ada取消回港消息感失落。健碩等連日跟蹤永健，察覺他喜拍攝街上少女，國棟請婉芳協助引永健再犯案。永健果然色心暗起，國棟見永健有所行動即拘捕他。國棟獲炳基讚賞並推薦升任警司。可人心理全面康復，再投入談判工作。國寶成功投考警察。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 秀茂坪某學校附近驚現中年裸男，校方提醒學生出入小心。節目組接獲某單幢大廈的居民投訴，指稱有住戶父子於屋苑內橫行霸道，威嚇及辱罵其他居民，甚至疑似包庇管理員的不當行為。外景主持嘗試向該對父子探問情況，對方不但否認指控，更反指是遭有心人誣蔑？《2026香港小姐競選》全球招募記者會，多位前港姐亦到場支持，送上活動花絮。有國際連鎖零售集團慶祝創立185周年，並於早前舉行店舖及員工頒獎禮。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 一項研究稱射精與可減低患前列腺癌風險或有關，泌尿外科醫生概述研究結果，還提醒男士如出現血精或小便帶血，應及早求醫。醫生亦詳析前列腺癌診治資訊，並建議多吃煮熟的番茄作預防。薛家燕回顧入行68年，感恩能將興趣變成終身事業。她憶述於《六指琴魔》反串一事，更難忘獲前輩梁醒波提攜！家燕姐從未演奸角，應大王所求首次擺出「奸相」。據悉她被長女「勒令」減少工作，可有其事？「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「酸蘿蔔豬肉湯」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 多項研究發現，男士出現脫髮的人口比率約20%，比例相當高。《醫度講》這集請來莊鍶敏細談如何受到脫髮問題影響，陳佔耀醫生則詳析脫髮的成因與治療方法。註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會在節目中跟大家分享有助改善脫髮情況的食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#21粵
programme.desc: 雙春與九妹決定回吳篤村前向若嵐辭行，遇上食客鼓譟，九妹只得暫代大廚之職。食客對菜式大表滿意，南天王心腹李先生更邀請喜相逢成為佼佼鎮的代表參加「省港澳廚藝比試」。永禎請字畫鑑賞家檢驗安山的遺書，得知是偽造。永禎用「調戲喜伯妻子」一事要脅關氏兄弟用轎把雙春抬回鎮中。永禎跟蹤曼娣，終得知她與飛揚間的關係。永禎欲灌醉飛揚套取消息，卻只得知他甚痛恨永安山。飛揚帶永禎談生意時遇佟大貴；飛揚突然要永禎離開。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#89粵
programme.desc: 強訛稱慶兩個月沒發工資而不給家用，眾提議將他辭退。妙下定決心辭退強。但強知道此事後假扮在藥房內跌倒，令喜難以辭退他。受傷的強變本加厲，除向義索取保險賠償，四出借錢，最後更帶家人到藥房要求供膳。

programme.title: 尚食#29粵普PG
programme.desc: 子衿要懲治蘇月華，孟尚宮自損雙手代月華贖罪，並辭去尚宮一職。災荒多發，瞻基對工部勞民傷財之舉十分不滿，下令減少宮內開支。子衿查閱宮廷帳冊，向太后指出負責採買的內宦貪污嚴重，並故意讓袁琦聽見。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

programme.desc: 義發現朋因蛀牙而發嚕囌，但朋因畏疾忌醫，眾人出盡方法，才令朋去看牙醫。義陪同朋到了診所後，卻因有突發公事，令義唯有讓朋單獨留在診所中。當義回到牙醫診所時，赫然發現牙醫被人打至昏迷不醒，朋更失去蹤影！

programme.title: 尚食#30粵普
programme.desc: 子衿用計讓瞻基看到被驅逐的災民；瞻基微服出訪，看盡百姓疾苦而心情鬱結，子衿備好膳食等他歸來並溫言相撫。胡皇后召見子衿，子衿表示胡皇后恨自己是因為胡尚食一事，但她坐上后位之後，也令自己沒有立錐之地。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 各種鮑魚的肉質與味道皆有分別，適合不同煮法。「富貴譚」購入口感鮮嫩的南非鮮鮑，供鼎爺製作「醉鮑魚」。用當歸、桂皮等煮成白滷水汁後，如何令鮑魚更入味？懂得善用鮑魚殼，也可變成中藥「石決明」？「石決明日月魚湯」具有雙重明目功效，加入桂圓肉、杞子則可中和苦澀味。糯米有新舊之分，用途有何差異？阿爺選用黑糖四物膏作八寶之一，取其甜味之餘，更有助補氣血。將雞翼拆骨後，釀入已蒸熟的八寶料香煎，即成「八寶雞翼」。

流行都市粵

programme.desc: 本港有97%的39歲以上人士帶有水痘帶狀疱疹病毒，每三人就有一人有可能「生蛇」。本集邀來姜麗文訴說曾受生蛇問題困擾的情況，也有陳佔耀醫生為大家解構生蛇的成因與後遺症。此外，註冊中醫師何慧欣、營養師李澄琳會帶來治療這病症的食療和針灸方法。

programme.desc: 大貴到喜相逢吃飯，說雙春像他認識的王爺妃子……永禎求雙春以「美人計」接近大貴；大貴致電要脅飛揚替他運貨；婉君見飛揚神色有異地談電話，誤會他與若嵐談情。勝天答應助繼母對付若嵐。雙春與永禎發現吉慶樓的菜式竟抄襲喜相逢，而勝天成為了吉慶樓大股東，更設計奪去「省港澳廚藝比試」的代表權。曼娣稱永禎託自己調查大貴，要脅飛揚留在她身旁。永禎施計讓大貴在他與雙春前說出廿年前一切真相；大貴脫身後遇飛揚，再起爭執……

programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 附帶「廠長話」的指令才需要做，稍有遲疑就會做錯，有單腳企的小兵猶豫之際，卻失平衡引致失誤？小朋友亦要聽清指令，只要求放低腳，如同時放低手就會被淘汰！曲奇隊目標清晰，快速闖果園摘水果，縱然有小兵曾走錯方向，但隊伍仍能於一分鐘內完成任務。在芭菲精靈鼓勵下，薯片小兵能否挑戰更快的成績？砌漢堡包遊戲，似乎有小兵還未弄清哪塊麵包才是底層，耽誤了時間！芭菲精靈呼籲已完成一隊為對方打氣，某小兵甚至想出手幫忙？

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 館長等人在蜻蛉出發前一天舉辦「蜻蛉歡送盃」，其間文平正式向洋子求婚，並得到對方答允。蜻蛉留下一封信提醒權三各種事項，並著他不要忘記自己。臨別依依，權三一反前言，告訴蜻蛉可隨時回來。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 目前香港孕婦建議接種有三種疫苗：流感疫苗，dTap (百日咳 破傷風和黃喉三合一) ，RSV。解釋他們如何保護孕婦與初生嬰兒，並探討近兩年引進香港的RSV疫苗，從安全性，政府資助和公眾疑慮等角度呈現爭議，幫助觀眾理解該不該打，如何評估。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐保險呈獻：準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2800粵
programme.desc: 大四喜應邀前赴某群島表演，敢威不慎得罪島主之母。力蓮獲某人報訊，得知島主或會派殺手刺殺敢威，卻出於某些原因，樹根被錯認為敢威。敢威與尚善出埠公幹，無法聯絡，力蓮亦未能向樹根言明真相，遂找藉口搬進熊家暫住，並派人佈防暗中保護樹根。力蓮的出現令眾人苦不堪言，怎料情況其後卻有意想不到的轉變。另一方面，樹根對力蓮關心照料下，二人多了交流……最終，真的有殺手來襲，力蓮眼見樹根有危險，奮不顧身相救……

programme.title: I LOAN U 網上貸款平台呈獻：重案解密#2粵PG
programme.desc: 子瑤抱著嬰兒站在天台邊緣，凱斌和灼穎打算用人偶哄她交換，思怡請纓幫忙，交換時被子瑤撞倒在地，導致流產。灼穎把別人落在餐廳的超大玩偶帶回警局，玩偶發出惡臭引起凱斌的注意，割開玩偶一看，裡面竟有一個頭骨…

programme.title: 大生意人#22粵普
programme.desc: 平原代表兩江就兩淮鹽業與理查德談判，指出與李欽的賭約未到期，理查德讓步與平原簽約。為打敗理查德，平原計劃賣茶葉、絲綢、藥品到印度，他輾轉各地，又向安徽茶商會、老八家和財神採購，財神陪平原說服赫德幫忙。

programme.title: 海馬牌床褥呈獻：魔音女團粵
programme.desc: 「魔音」特訓班開課，十六人要從四首舞曲中挑選，並分四隊登上第一次考核舞台，揀歌前迎來突擊測驗。韓國舞蹈老師指導<Lucky Star三十秒舞步，練習生挑戰兩小時速成訓練，就要接受評核。具舞蹈底子的蔡華英自薦打頭陣，被指欠缺偶像特質？喬美莎縱有瑕疵，卻以臨場編舞掩蓋……隨後竟無人願上場，自言記舞較差的宋宛穎被點名，如何靠應變搭夠？有人驚到全程望住地下跳，演出失敗、錯到無法點評等狠評亦湧現，超殘酷！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.desc: 簡潔堂弟簡繼祖被警員拘捕，長旺求國棟相助。楊光欲撮合孝武與可人，惟孝武失戀創傷未癒，不想與可人展開新戀情。Joyce邀孝武出席舞會，當眾奚落他，幸可人及時替孝武解圍。楊光繼父楊守業不適，楊光陪他上班。孝文經常利用公款吃喝玩樂，並從交易中取利。孝文購入冒牌罐頭被顧客投訴，將責任推卸在採購經理吳大貴身上。守業得知是孝文引發事件，大責孝文。國棟正式升為警司。國棟陪簡潔到醫院檢查，赫見國樑與德明爭執。

programme.desc: 大貴到喜相逢吃飯，說雙春像他認識的王爺妃子……永禎求雙春以「美人計」接近大貴；大貴致電要脅飛揚替他運貨；婉君見飛揚神色有異地談電話，誤會他與若嵐談情。勝天答應助繼母對付若嵐。雙春與永禎發現吉慶樓的菜式竟抄襲喜相逢，而勝天成為了吉慶樓大股東，更設計奪去「省港澳廚藝比試」的代表權。曼娣稱永禎託自己調查大貴，要脅飛揚留在她身旁。永禎施計讓大貴在他與雙春前說出廿年前一切真相；大貴脫身後遇飛揚，再起爭執……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#90粵
programme.desc: 義發現朋因蛀牙而發嚕囌，但朋因畏疾忌醫，眾人出盡方法，才令朋去看牙醫。義陪同朋到了診所後，卻因有突發公事，令義唯有讓朋單獨留在診所中。當義回到牙醫診所時，赫然發現牙醫被人打至昏迷不醒，朋更失去蹤影！

programme.title: 尚食#30粵普
programme.desc: 子衿用計讓瞻基看到被驅逐的災民；瞻基微服出訪，看盡百姓疾苦而心情鬱結，子衿備好膳食等他歸來並溫言相撫。胡皇后召見子衿，子衿表示胡皇后恨自己是因為胡尚食一事，但她坐上后位之後，也令自己沒有立錐之地。

programme.title: 我係小廚神2粵
programme.desc: 小廚神走入有機農莊展示廚藝，六位分成兩人一組，合作炮製三餸一湯；還要就地採摘農莊的新鮮蔬果做菜。三位大廚評判加上陸浩明、鄧佩儀要在最低分的一組中，選出其中一名選手淘汰，誰可得勝利之神眷顧？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#91粵
programme.desc: 「有龜」離家出走！眾驚覺龜被店主四眼龜拾獲，四眼龜揚言絕不會歸還。不久惡客找四眼龜晦氣，有朋用鬥吃龜苓膏方式嚇跑惡客，成功感動到四眼龜將「有龜」歸還，可是，眾人發現此龜不是「有龜」，而高慶亦來到門前。

programme.title: 尚食#31粵普
programme.desc: 吳昭儀痛恨子衿, 找來蘇月華, 與她達成對付子衿的共識；還抓到袁琦的把柄脅迫他一起謀害子衿；子衿被下毒，皇帝把罪怪到皇后頭上，殷紫萍為皇后說項；宮女偷偷告訴紫萍，她曾看到蘇月華在桃花樹下翻找…

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 海蝦、東星斑、海參、花蟹齊集賀台慶，一於「撈起」成為「十全十美慶豐收」！每款食材都有不同的切法，雞皮亦切絲，增加味道層次。吃法豈止一種，將各款食材包入旺菜，蒸幾分鐘讓旺菜的甜味滲進材料，又是另一番滋味。鼎爺、阿譚趁台慶夜分享於TVB創造過的威水史，再用花蟹、蝦仁與蓮藕混和做出金黃大球般的蓮藕丸子，祝福TVB「財源滾滾」！蓮藕何以要一半磨蓉一半切粒？丸子蘸麵包糠前要蘸蛋白，為甚麼不用蛋黃？

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 破壞性情緒失調症(DMDD)主要出現於兒童與青少年，特徵是長期嚴重易怒及反覆情緒爆發。患者常因小事而反應激烈，甚至摔物或攻擊他人；類似行為在孩童身上偶爾也會發生，如何診斷是患上DMDD？精神科醫生亦細說如何透過認知行為治療此症，家長又可怎樣從旁疏導指引？乳癌常見症狀包括乳房出現硬塊、乳頭有異常分泌物等，臨床腫瘤科醫生指這症分為不同亞型，並詳述診治資訊。「睇餸食飯」，小儀師傅示範「清香酸甜不見天」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 本地有調查發現，近六分之一受訪者患灰甲，為數不少，值得大家關注。《醫度講》這集請來鄧英敏細談如何受到灰甲問題困擾，陳佔耀醫生則為大家解構灰甲的成因與併發症。此外，註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，會跟觀眾分享有助改善灰甲問題的食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#23粵
programme.desc: 雙春見永禎為大貴逃走一事消沉不已，特意放下工作陪他到戶外喝酒及安慰他。九妹決定獨自回吳篤村，飛揚卻鼓勵他爭取所愛。永禎得知大貴死去，到義莊查看，九妹從大貴手中發現袖口鈕……勝天竟帶警察捉拿永禎；雙春終看不過眼向勝天說他的真正身分。若嵐向飛揚詢問遺書之事，飛揚指這樣只是不忍永禎為追查父親之死耗費光陰。永禎在街上公開指飛揚殺人，如冰竟要他離開，雙春追出迫問他的心意；永禎終哭著說出真相，卻被九妹聽到。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: Beatbox利用口部發出模仿樂器或節奏的聲音，是從美國興起的Hip Hop文化之一，常與Rap唱一同表演。「Kids’ Notes」請到Beatbox導師為大家示範幾款不同風格的音樂節奏，Tiffany姐姐也心急想學基本功。此外，兩位小學員前來錄影廠表演技藝，並細談深刻演出經歷。學Beatbox既可增加對音樂的認識，也有助提升專注力與自信心。導師還提到聽過不少家長表示，學員的情緒也有所改善？

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 蜻蛉與五十嵐聲音導航，帶大家回顧島上發生的種種。五十嵐初到火之島，阿圓為蜻蛉帶來新刺激，去惡礫島挑戰垢多設計的球洞，如今蜻蛉初中畢業，終於要離開火之島，為自己的故事寫下新篇章。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
programme.desc: 大圍站拆卸重建的新盤交樓，廚房玻璃驗到崩花，露台掃口有罅隙，整體質素如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 渣打香港呈獻：財富之道粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2801粵
programme.desc: Rebecca獲安排與龔燁面見某位年輕貌美的應徵者，竟加以刁難還趕走她。龔燁其後發現她與該應徵者竟因應考某場公開試而認識，似乎存心針對對方。另一方面，龔燁認為Rebecca經常利用若水，若水更因要頂替休假的Rebecca工作，而無法跟他慶祝拍拖紀念日。龔燁偶然發現Rebecca請假是要參加補考，並只為戲弄其他考生，遂為阻止她而作出不少嘗試……最終，龔燁得知她應考的真正原因，務要設法彌補過錯……

programme.title: I LOAN U 網上貸款平台呈獻：重案解密#3粵PG
programme.desc: 灼穎重遇中學時暗戀的師兄浩文；浩文當年與家敏交往，後來更成了癮君子。警方調查榮恩曾任職的保險公司，發現前上司楚君有所隱瞞…通話紀錄顯示家敏與瑞年有聯絡，警方遂到瑞年開的派對房間調查，發現楚君匆忙逃離…

programme.title: 大生意人#23粵普PG
programme.desc: 紫軒答應借船給平原把貨物賣到英國。事件驚動朝廷，要把平原押解進京，抄沒家產；平原卻樂觀面對，還讓玉兒等他出來為孩兒起名。理查德要求瑞麟把貨船截停，瑞麟讓他到牢中去找平原，平原提出要回鹽田的地契作交換…

programme.title: 海馬牌床褥呈獻：魔音女團粵
programme.desc: 速成訓練評核，最後一位登場挑戰者，與不少練習生一樣，遭到嚴厲批評！點名公佈首四名練習生，她們會出任四首舞曲的隊長，並帶領四人團隊呈現初舞台演出。其餘十二人可自由入隊，但若某隊人數超額，隊長就要慎重考慮，決定將誰人推出隊外。也有練習生私下打算「抱團」，卻事與願違？訓練展開，陳奐仁要求眾人不斷重複練習；倪嘉雯向另一班主任陳潔靈請教，如何保持笑容並張口唱歌。初舞台前，節目組安排親友特別場，讓各隊預演……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#21粵PG
programme.desc: 德明提出分手，國樑激動，國棟始發現國樑是同性戀者。孝武邀可人於情人節約會，表明心意。楊光放大假，於家族生意昌隆幫手。因冒牌罐頭事件，令公司損失了由供應商趙創發給予的優惠價買貨，守業、楊光找創發道歉，創發指事件令其商譽受損，拒絕再合作。楊光用誠意打動創發續給優惠價，受祖母羅麗君讚賞。國棟覺楊光乃可造之材，故不時考驗楊光，乘機傳授談判技巧。國樑離家出走，危立天台企圖自殺。國棟欲勸他放棄自殺，惟未成功。

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Altamira
programme.desc: Chip y los átomos entran en una cueva llena de pinturas en las paredes. Una puerta bloquea el paso a la cueva en un lugar donde se apilan células de elementos químicos y un horno. Siguiendo las indicaciones de las pinturas y con la ayuda del libro de química de Chip, descubre que debe mezclar y fusionar varios elementos para crear unos zapatos de vidrio con los que pueda caminar sobre un suelo lleno de ácido, de modo que la puerta se levante y pueda seguir el camino. programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La carga

Así, con la ayuda de átomos de bromo prisioneros, logra destruir el transporte y su peligrosa carga.

programme.desc: God’s Gang faces insane challenges - from stopping a mad scientist to battling aliens and saving blue whales.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyson the Tanker refuels Jeremy
programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Francis the Forklift helps at the construction site
programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyler the Tyke steals candy
programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Hospital
programme.desc: Doctor Bluey is needed when Dad gets a very curious x-ray from Nurse Bingo. It seems he has a cat in his tummy!

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Squash
programme.desc: When dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Driving
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Towel

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Harvest Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is getting ready to harvest the ripe crops that grown. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Space Badge
programme.desc: Duggee teaches the squirrels all about the stars, the planets and the Milky Way!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Spooky Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing dress up when they hear a ghostly sound. What is going on?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Wimbledon, England
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are at Centre Court in Wimbledon to watch the world's most famous tennis tournament.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Great Mosque of Djenne, Africa
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is invited to Djenne in Mali, Africa, to visit the people and to see one of his favourite things at work - mud.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends (S24) - Emily's Best Friend
programme.desc: Emily worries that she doesn't have a best friend. Soon she realises she's been surrounded by best friends all along.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Music Fixer
programme.desc: Sarah's Tuba is making some very peculiar sounds, so a trip to the Music Shop is in order.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Wool on Wheels
programme.desc: Scarf Lady is holding a 'knitted treats' sale in the park, but the weather is causing a problem...

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Power
programme.desc: Stanley needs to do some jobs for the community, but all his vehicles are out of power due to a cloud of butterflies obscuring them and he needs to figure out how to move them.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Promises

programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Desserts of Destiny
programme.desc: Evil Pea lures Supertato and Tomato into her cave of frosted doom. Can they find the courage to avoid her traps and retrieve The Lost Candle of Birthdays for Tomato's Museum?

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Running Around in Circles
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po run around in circles in Home Dome. The Noo-Noo joins in and the Teletubbies have fun chasing.

programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say `hedgehog', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. Today we meet lots of hedgehogs: a brown hedgehog, a small hedgehog, a snuffling hedgehog and a hungry hedgehog.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. The Squirrels take an epic journey to give it back.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - The Blarney Stone, Ireland

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Daddy Robot
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo don't want to tidy the playroom, so they get Daddy Robot to do it. But when Bluey takes things too far, Daddy Robot malfunctions!

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Stumpfest
programme.desc: Dad and his mates hit the backyard, ready to rip up some tree stumps! But when Bluey and Bingo take over a stump as a nail salon, Dad finds he's got some negotiating to do.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of fluffing in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby European Pond Turtle
programme.desc: In this episode, Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to the Danube river in Vienna, Austria on a baby animal mission to help a newly hatched European pond turtle reach water. Along the way, the intrepid team witness the emergence of ten million mayflies.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Ball
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun playing with their favourite red bouncy ball. It drops into the Ice Disco, giving Hettie the Yeti an idea for a bouncy dance!

programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels prepare for a campfire by collecting sticks of all sizes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Harvest Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is getting ready to harvest the ripe crops that grown. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Cave of Crystals, Mexico

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - The Great Little Railway Show
programme.desc: When a Railway Show for little engines comes to Sodor, an overly excited Percy finally sees his chance to shine.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Lemon Cafe
programme.desc: Sarah &amp; Duck discover a Lemon Cafe in the park, but it seems to be nearly closing time...

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Star Renovation
programme.desc: Venus has attempted to redecorate the night sky, but now Sarah can't find any of her favourite constellations...

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Den
programme.desc: Little Woo and Seamus call Stanley to help them build a den so they can watch the bugs in the forest without disturbing them. Stanley builds a giant, camouflaged den on legs.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Shipwreck
programme.desc: Benjamin and Hettie find an old treasure map that leads to Blue Whiskers' Pirate Shipwreck! They ask Stanley to help them find it and maybe bring it back to show the townsfolk.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - Your Brother is Really Naughty
programme.desc: The talking animals chat about all the good and bad things about having a brother or a sister.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to dance
programme.desc: Gran Gran busts a groove when she teaches JoJo the moves to a traditional Saint Lucian dance. JoJo finds that learning a dance can take time, before realising she can put her own twist on it.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.desc: Evil Pea lures Supertato and Tomato into her cave of frosted doom. Can they find the courage to avoid her traps and retrieve The Lost Candle of Birthdays for Tomato's Museum?

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po run around in circles in Home Dome. The Noo-Noo joins in and the Teletubbies have fun chasing.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow" is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar "Drunken Cat" who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Fans of the international star Alexander Fu Sheng were aghast. Their idol had broken both his legs and was recuperating. Everyone wondered: would he be able to return to the action comedies for which he was so famous? This movie was the answer, and it left no doubt that he had made a full recovery. Liu Chia-yung, brother of preeminent martial arts moviemaker Liu Chia-liang, was famous in his own right for kung-fu comedies, and he out-did himself with this one.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous "Twin Swords" in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by "Drunken Master", this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a pretty fraud, steals a brilliant diamond ring from a shop in Hong Kong and escapes to Singapore. To smuggle the ring pass customs, Hua slips it into the pocket of a stranger, Yen, but then lost track of him. Hua finally spots Yen after searching for days and does everything to get close to him in order to take the ring back.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father's martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung's passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu's disciple.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors...

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy "House of 72 tenants", this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium house's owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Zheng Shi Qing Chun Cui Can Shi - EP1
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&amp;B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Maybe It's Love

Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions.
